Concert disrupted by fan behavior at Shillong festival

International artists Swae Lee and Khalid experienced disruptions during their performances at the Shillong Cherry Blossom Festival. Reports indicate that fans threw beer and T-shirts onto the stage. One viral video showed a young fan enthusiastically dancing to Swae Lee's song 'Sunflower' at the concert.
